title: 6 Things a Godly Man's Single Years Are For
caption:
6 things a godly man's single years are for. None of them are finding a wife.

Building the discipline she'll actually get to live with. Learning to be alone with God without needing anyone else in the room, Psalm 62:1 wasn't written for a crowd. Killing the sins nobody's checking up on yet.

Practicing the brotherhood you'll still need after the wedding. Learning what leading costs before anyone's life depends on it. Praying for a woman you haven't met yet instead of chasing one you have.

The order changes you more than it changes the outcome.

#faith #singleness #christianmen #manofgod #purpose #brotherhood
theme: He chases God, not a wife.
